dependency_summary.impact: Each node cannot be started without the fixed version from the preceding step, so a single delay becomes a delay of the final baseline as-is
dependency_summary.mitigation: Reserve the review dates for each fixed version in advance, working backwards from the decision-making meeting (SYS1-01-n)

dependency_summary.title: External lead time — research
dependency_summary.content: User interviews and quantitative research take several weeks from arrangement to results
dependency_summary.impact: While waiting on research results, the value-proposition definition and the business-viability assessment cannot be fixed, and everything downstream stops
dependency_summary.mitigation: In parallel with designing the questionnaire, get ahead on arranging the research agency and fixing the screening conditions

dependency_summary.title: External lead time — data provision
dependency_summary.content: Inquiries to other departments about whether data can be provided take time to answer, and may be refused
dependency_summary.impact: The integration scope cannot be fixed, so the function allocation diagram and the interface candidates cannot be decided
dependency_summary.mitigation: Send out the inquiry first even while the required-data list is still coarse, and decide the answer deadline and how a non-answer will be handled

dependency_summary.title: Hard deadline
dependency_summary.content: The SOP and IVI specification-freeze date of the target vehicle model dictate the overall deadline
dependency_summary.impact: Integration that entails vehicle-side ECU changes will not make it in time, requiring a re-sorting of the initial release scope
dependency_summary.mitigation: Set the issues that entail vehicle-side changes as the top priority, and set their decision deadlines working backwards from the specification freeze (SYS1-07-h)

dependency_summary.title: Confluence point (where things tend to jam) — plan narrowing
dependency_summary.content: The three series — experience, integration, and business viability — converge at the narrowing of the plan
dependency_summary.impact: If even one series' draft version is missing, scope sorting cannot be done and the matter cannot be tabled at the decision-making meeting
dependency_summary.mitigation: Set the draft-version deadlines of all three series on the same day, and decide in advance the rule for setting placeholder premises when one is missing

dependency_summary.title: Confluence point (where things tend to jam) — specification integration
dependency_summary.content: Requirements, screens, allocation, flows, and sequences converge at the specification integration
dependency_summary.path_raw: SYS2-11-n + SYS2-12-p + SYS2-13-l + SYS2-14-l + SYS2-15-l → SYS2-16-b → SYS2-16-e
dependency_summary.impact: Deliverables at mismatched revisions get mixed together, causing massive rework during the consistency check
dependency_summary.mitigation: Cross-check the revision numbers of each deliverable before integration, and unify the ID notation rules before authoring begins (SYS2-16-a)

dependency_summary.title: Work that can run in parallel — competitor research
dependency_summary.content: Competitor research can partly run in parallel with refining the value proposition
dependency_summary.path_raw: SYS1-03-a through -f can start partway through SYS1-02
dependency_summary.impact: If not parallelized, waiting on the arrangement of actual vehicles for the research becomes the cause of delay
dependency_summary.mitigation: Fix the comparison-target list early, and get ahead with arranging test drives and rentals

dependency_summary.title: Work that can run in parallel — flowcharts and sequence diagrams
dependency_summary.content: Flowcharts and sequence diagrams can run in parallel once the requirements list is fixed
dependency_summary.path_raw: SYS2-14 and SYS2-15 run in parallel after SYS2-12-p
dependency_summary.impact: Doing them serially delays the start of specification integration by 2–3 weeks
dependency_summary.mitigation: Prepare the description guides (SYS2-14-b / SYS2-15-b) first, split the assignments, and start both at once

dependency_summary.title: Path prone to rework — PoC results
dependency_summary.content: Requirement values change as a result of the PoC / prototype
dependency_summary.path_raw: SYS2-16-i → SYS2-16-j → updates to the requirements list, screens, flows, and sequences
dependency_summary.impact: Already-fixed deliverables have to be revised again, delaying baselining
dependency_summary.mitigation: Tag the values that may change (thresholds, character-count limits, timeouts) with a provisional value and an issue ID, and list the places to be updated in advance

dependency_summary.title: Path prone to rework — conditional decisions
dependency_summary.content: If the condition of a conditional decision is not met, it switches to the alternative proposal
dependency_summary.impact: The requirements, allocation, and sequences that presuppose integration all have to be swapped out together
dependency_summary.mitigation: State the alternative for an unmet condition explicitly at decision time, and keep the integration-dependent descriptions separated out of the basic flow
